text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hussein received many messages of congratulation on the Moslem Eid al-Fitr feast before heading off on a tour of Britain, Ireland, Germany and Morocco.
- Prince Abdallah, deputising for King Hussein, congratulates Iran on 18th anniversary of Islamic revolution.
- Cabinet decides to double doctors' bonuses to 60 percent of basic salary for those doing extra work.
- Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to visit Jordan after king's return from abroad. Palestinian-Jordanian committee to hold its first meeting in Palestinian-ruled territories.
- King Hussein telephoned Iraqi President Saddam Hussein to exchange Eid al-Fitr greetings in the first direct contact between the two leaders since September 1990.
